inputbooster.options.title: InputBooster
inputbooster.option.perf_gpu: GPU: Hand Off To Renderer Mods
inputbooster.option.perf_chunk: Chunks: Hand Off To Renderer Mods
inputbooster.profiles.empty: No profiles saved yet. Use the buttons below to store the current setup.
inputbooster.stats.unavailable: Session statistics are not available yet — the mod is still initialising.
inputbooster.tip.poll_rate: How often the input is sampled between game ticks. Manual mode pins this value; automatic mode adapts it to your frame rate.
inputbooster.tip.burst_mode: Temporarily pushes the poll rate to 1000 Hz while you are fighting.
inputbooster.tip.combo_keys: Enables the Ctrl + 1..5 poll rate shortcuts.
inputbooster.tip.preset: Switch to manual mode and apply this poll rate.
inputbooster.tip.sprint_fix: Keeps sprint from dropping when a movement key is re-pressed.
inputbooster.tip.wtap_assist: Re-presses forward immediately after an attack.
inputbooster.tip.anti_idle: Periodically nudges movement so the server does not time you out.
inputbooster.tip.cps_limiter: Caps how many attacks per second the mod will emit.
inputbooster.tip.max_cps: Hard upper bound for the limiter. Lower it if you want a safe ceiling.
inputbooster.tip.click_sounds: Plays a click sound for every emitted click.
inputbooster.tip.click_pitch: Pitch multiplier of the click sound.
inputbooster.tip.hud_overlay: Shows the poll rate badge on the in-game HUD.
inputbooster.tip.action_bar: Prints mod status messages above the hotbar.
inputbooster.tip.overlay_position: Which screen corner the overlay is anchored to.
inputbooster.tip.overlay_scale: Scales the overlay about its anchor corner.
inputbooster.tip.overlay_opacity: Fades the overlay out. Zero hides it completely.
inputbooster.tip.safe_mode: Shuts the mod down automatically if it throws.
inputbooster.tip.debug_mode: Logs extra detail to the game log.
inputbooster.tip.event_log: Keeps an in-game log of the actions the mod emitted.
inputbooster.tip.key_conflict: Warns when a mod key binding collides with a vanilla one.
inputbooster.tip.per_server_profiles: Switches profiles automatically when you join a server.
inputbooster.tip.fps_check: How often, in ticks, the adaptive poll rate is recomputed.
inputbooster.tip.perf_cpu: Derives the server identity at most once per engine window instead of on every tick.
inputbooster.tip.perf_memory: Rebuilds the key snapshot and binding set only when something changed, removing every-tick allocations.
inputbooster.tip.perf_disk: Collects settings changes and writes the config once on a background thread instead of on the render thread.
inputbooster.tip.perf_input: Drops the input poller to 20 Hz on menus and while paused. Nothing is sampled there that could be kept, so nothing is lost.
inputbooster.tip.perf_gpu: The engine adds no rendering work of its own; rendering stays with vanilla, Sodium or Iris. Toggling this records that hand-off.
inputbooster.tip.perf_chunk: Chunk scheduling stays with vanilla, Sodium and Lithium — a second scheduler is the classic crash source. The engine touches no chunk.
inputbooster.tip.perf_adaptive: Runs the engine checks on a slowing window when nothing is pending, so its steady-state cost is one comparison per tick.
inputbooster.tip.perf_interval: How often, in ticks, the engine evaluates its modules. Higher values cost less; 600 is about every 30 seconds.
inputbooster.tip.perf_debounce: How long, in milliseconds, settings changes are collected before one background write.
inputbooster.tip.cps_graph: Clicks per second over the last 60 seconds, coloured against your CPS cap.
inputbooster.tip.reset_peak: Clears the recorded worst-case input latency.
inputbooster.tip.load_profile: Applies every setting stored in this profile.
inputbooster.tip.quick_save: Stores the current settings under this name.
